CREATE TABLE stock_loss_correction_executions (
	correction_decision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reversal_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	disposition VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	return_operation_id CHAR(32), 
	source_account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_account_id CHAR(32), 
	custody_assignment_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	posting_transaction_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	posting_movement_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	plan_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	plan_jsonb JSON NOT NULL, 
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	root_disposition_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_person_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	authorization_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	command_jsonb JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_execution_request UNIQUE (actor_user_id, request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_execution_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_execution_root UNIQUE (id, root_disposition_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_correction_execution_context CHECK (authorization_version > 0 AND length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 500), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_correction_execution_request CHECK (length(request_id) BETWEEN 8 AND 160 AND length(idempotency_key_hash)=64 AND length(request_hash)=64), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_correction_execution_decision FOREIGN KEY(correction_decision_id, root_disposition_id, reversal_id, disposition) REFERENCES stock_loss_correction_decisions (id, root_disposition_id, reversal_id, disposition) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_execution_inverse UNIQUE (reversal_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_execution_decision UNIQUE (correction_decision_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_execution_tx UNIQUE (posting_transaction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_execution_move UNIQUE (posting_movement_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_correction_execution_return UNIQUE (return_operation_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_correction_execution_kind CHECK (disposition IN ('restore_available','convert_used','convert_damaged','return_to_region','scrap')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_correction_execution_accounts CHECK ((disposition='scrap' AND target_account_id IS NULL) OR (disposition<>'scrap' AND target_account_id IS NOT NULL AND source_account_id<>target_account_id)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_correction_execution_return CHECK ((disposition='return_to_region' AND return_operation_id IS NOT NULL) OR (disposition<>'return_to_region' AND return_operation_id IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_correction_execution_plan CHECK (quantity > 0 AND length(plan_hash)=64), 
	FOREIGN KEY(return_operation_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_orders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(custody_assignment_id) REFERENCES custody_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(posting_transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	FOREIGN KEY(posting_movement_id) REFERENCES inventory_movements (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_dispositions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_person_id) REFERENCES people (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE stock_loss_request_key_bindings (
	fact_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	binding_kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	root_disposition_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	key_token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reversal_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	approval_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	correction_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	inverse_id CHAR(32), 
	approval_id CHAR(32), 
	correction_id CHAR(32), 
	seal_id CHAR(32), 
	approval_seal_id CHAR(32), 
	correction_seal_id CHAR(32), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (fact_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_request_binding_request UNIQUE (actor_user_id, request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT stock_loss_request_key_bindings_key_token_key UNIQUE (key_token), 
	CONSTRAINT stock_loss_request_key_bindings_reversal_key_hash_key UNIQUE (reversal_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT stock_loss_request_key_bindings_approval_key_hash_key UNIQUE (approval_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT stock_loss_request_key_bindings_correction_key_hash_key UNIQUE (correction_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_request_binding_inverse FOREIGN KEY(inverse_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_disposition_reversals (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_request_binding_approval FOREIGN KEY(approval_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_correction_decisions (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_request_binding_correction FOREIGN KEY(correction_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_correction_executions (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_request_binding_seal FOREIGN KEY(seal_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_inverse_request_seals (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_request_binding_approval_seal FOREIGN KEY(approval_seal_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_correction_approval_seals (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_request_binding_correction_seal FOREIGN KEY(correction_seal_id, root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_correction_execution_seals (id, root_disposition_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_request_binding_kind CHECK ((binding_kind='inverse' AND inverse_id=fact_id AND inverse_id IS NOT NULL AND approval_id IS NULL AND correction_id IS NULL AND seal_id IS NULL AND approval_seal_id IS NULL AND correction_seal_id IS NULL) OR (binding_kind='approval' AND approval_id=fact_id AND approval_id IS NOT NULL AND inverse_id IS NULL AND correction_id IS NULL AND seal_id IS NULL AND approval_seal_id IS NULL AND correction_seal_id IS NULL) OR (binding_kind='correction' AND correction_id=fact_id AND correction_id IS NOT NULL AND inverse_id IS NULL AND approval_id IS NULL AND seal_id IS NULL AND approval_seal_id IS NULL AND correction_seal_id IS NULL) OR (binding_kind='inverse_seal' AND seal_id=fact_id AND seal_id IS NOT NULL AND inverse_id IS NULL AND approval_id IS NULL AND correction_id IS NULL AND approval_seal_id IS NULL AND correction_seal_id IS NULL) OR (binding_kind='approval_seal' AND approval_seal_id=fact_id AND approval_seal_id IS NOT NULL AND inverse_id IS NULL AND approval_id IS NULL AND correction_id IS NULL AND seal_id IS NULL AND correction_seal_id IS NULL) OR (binding_kind='correction_seal' AND correction_seal_id=fact_id AND correction_seal_id IS NOT NULL AND inverse_id IS NULL AND approval_id IS NULL AND correction_id IS NULL AND seal_id IS NULL AND approval_seal_id IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_request_binding_digests CHECK ((length(request_hash)=64 AND request_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*') AND (length(key_token)=64 AND key_token NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*') AND (length(reversal_key_hash)=64 AND reversal_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*') AND (length(approval_key_hash)=64 AND approval_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*') AND (length(correction_key_hash)=64 AND correction_key_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*') AND reversal_key_hash<>approval_key_hash AND reversal_key_hash<>correction_key_hash AND approval_key_hash<>correction_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_request_binding_request CHECK (length(request_id) BETWEEN 8 AND 160 AND request_id NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9._:-]*'), 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_dispositions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_custody_assignment_id) REFERENCES custody_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_location_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,

	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	plan_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	command_jsonb JSON NOT NULL,
	plan_jsonb JSON NOT NULL,

	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	loss_headquarters_decision_id CHAR(32),

	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_no UNIQUE (operation_no),

	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_typed_id UNIQUE (id, operation_type),

	CONSTRAINT ck_stock_operation_orders_context CHECK (authorization_version > 0 AND length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_posting UNIQUE (posting_transaction_id),
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key_hash),

	FOREIGN KEY(transit_location_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(posting_transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
	FOREIGN KEY(requester_id) REFERENCES people (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(source_location_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(target_custody_assignment_id) REFERENCES custody_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(target_location_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(oam_work_order_id) REFERENCES oam_work_orders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_order_posting_id UNIQUE (id, posting_transaction_id),
	FOREIGN KEY(loss_correction_decision_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_correction_decisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE,
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_correction_decision UNIQUE (loss_correction_decision_id)
)

CREATE TABLE "stock_loss_dispositions" (

	executor_person_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	posting_movement_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
	authorization_version BIGINT NOT NULL,
	disposition VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
	quantity NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL,
	request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	idempotency_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	plan_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	command_jsonb JSON NOT NULL,
	plan_jsonb JSON NOT NULL,
	return_operation_id CHAR(32),
	scrap_operation_id CHAR(32),
	PRIMARY KEY (id),
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_disposition_dimensions CHECK (quantity>0 AND authorization_version>0 AND ((disposition='scrap' AND target_account_id IS NULL) OR (disposition<>'scrap' AND target_account_id IS NOT NULL AND source_account_id<>target_account_id))),
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_disposition_hashes CHECK (length(request_hash)=64 AND length(plan_hash)=64 AND length(idempotency_key_hash)=64),
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_disposition_transaction UNIQUE (posting_transaction_id),
	CONSTRAINT ck_loss_disposition_request CHECK (length(request_id) BETWEEN 8 AND 160),
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_disposition_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key_hash),
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_disposition_original_decision UNIQUE (headquarters_decision_id),
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_disposition_original_line UNIQUE (line_id),
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_disposition_movement UNIQUE (posting_movement_id),
	CONSTRAINT uq_loss_disposition_request UNIQUE (actor_user_id, request_id),
	CONSTRAINT fk_loss_disposition_return_operation FOREIGN KEY(return_operation_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_orders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
